notes.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello, all! 

Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3, the latest game from Strange Scaffold (that's us!) is out now!

[previewyoutube=69Gn_8tCrMs;full][/previewyoutube]
Put on your most appropriate mansion-traversing boots and get ready to go on a one-of-a-kind adventure with J.J. Hardwell in Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3. We’ve [b]discounted the game for launch[/b] - hopefully this can allow more folks the opportunity to celebrate with us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2116510/Creepy_Redneck_Dinosaur_Mansion_3/

Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is a match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania. For a deeper lore dive, we invite you to check out this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2116510/discussions/0/595146546178205360/]FAQ post[/url] we've put together.

See you in the mansion!

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Minor end of service fixes
notes.notes: An option to force keyboard prompts has been added to the settings and a small tweak has been made to the armor hit indicator to stop it from rotating along with the aiming reticle.

notes.title: March 20 Minor Update
notes.notes: Small fixes to the enemy radio chatter at the start of Story level 7 and more consistency with when the interaction prompt is displayed.

notes.title: Update 18th of March
notes.notes: Just a small patch to fix and issue that would sometimes break the Overview screen at the end of the level. Thanks to everyone who spoke up about it!

notes.title: TMNT: Tactical Takedown OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

[i]Splinter and Shredder are dead, and as the Turtles approach adulthood, they're not just growing up... they're growing apart.[/i]

We’re INCREDIBLY excited to announce that Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is  [b]OUT NOW[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=9wNkdfZQ1Es;full][/previewyoutube]
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown is our turn-based TMNT game. Inspired by the classic cartoon, you'll experience a new approach to the world of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in this tactical brawler.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3229100/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Tactical_Takedown/
This is a HUGE moment for us here at Strange Scaffold and we are so proud to get to work in the world of the Turtles! 

We hope you enjoy it, and if you do, tell a friend!

See you on the internet, 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Cold Sweat is Out NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone

Our final content update, Cold Sweat, is out now! This update brings new story-free levels that up the [b]challenge[/b] and extend the [i]weird[/i]. It also features a remix of TYRANTS BETTER RUN by Mega Ran, so yeah, we’re pretty excited about this one!

This content update is a huge THANK YOU to you, the community. We would not have been able to offer this level of support and content updates without you. We would also like to thank our playtesters who have been invaluable as we have developed this game.

For real, [b]THANK YOU ALL![/b]

We can’t wait to see the times you get on this one, 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Minor Update for 31st December
notes.notes:
A warm welcome to any new players jumping in! Just a small patch to fix our Discord invite link.

Hope that everyone has a good new year; we'll see you in 2025!

notes.title: Vote for I Am Your Beast in the Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

We’ve been blown away by the response to I Am Your Beast and want to say thank you to everyone who has taken the time to play, review, stream, make videos, and tell their friends about the game! We’d really appreciate it if you’d consider nominating I Am Your Beast in the Best Soundtrack category. We also think some of these might fit…

- Outstanding Visual Style
- GOTY

In case you missed it, our latest update also includes a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1876590/view/4486243201365049737?l=english]free story epilogue[/url], so be sure to check that out. Also, you can get the game for 20% off during the Autumn Sale right now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876590/

Again, thank you all so much! 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: November 25th Minor Patch
notes.notes:
- Hand placed weapons will no longer disappear in wave levels
- Fix to credits
- Fix to intro dialogue being cut off in Support Group levels
- Sniper lasers will no longer persist after a sniper is destroyed
- Minor fixes to Support Group levels

notes.title: November 23rd Minor Update
notes.notes:
- Small balance updates for the Support Group levels
- Spoiler notice on opening the Support Group level pack for the first time 
- Updated credits

notes.title: Story Expansion Update out now!
notes.notes:
Hello, all!

It’s finally here! The new story expansion sees a new epilogue added to the end of the game where you’ll sit in as a part of the COI Support Group. Tall tales are swapped across nine levels, with ten new cutscenes and extreme situations for Harding to force his opponents through that you don't typically experience in the main game. 

We’ve said it before, and we’re going to keep saying it, but this wouldn’t be possible without you! Your support of the game has enabled us to make these new levels and have fun with such a cool concept.

Look forward to more support for the game in 2025--and see you around the internet!

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Steam Items are here for I Am Your Beast!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! 

We’ve added a bunch of new Steam items to I Am Your Beast! While we may not have nukes, knives and sharp sticks we do have cards, emotes, profile backgrounds and badges.

You should find some of these unlocked already if you’ve been playing through the game. 

We’ve got a number of bigger updates on the horizon, including some new content for the game! I know we say it often in these updates but we couldn’t continue to support this game if it wasn’t for your passion and support. We are eternally thankful and constantly amazed at the things we’ve seen you do in the game.

Speaking of, if you want to see some of the times others are getting, or just share your own, we’ve updated our [url=https://discord.gg/dog-airport-game]Discord server[/url] so it’s shiny, new and waiting for you. 

See you on the internet, 

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Feature Update and Bug Fixes October 2024
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone! 

We’ve just released a new update that adds some expanded features and quality of life updates, these include:
[list]
[*] [b]Expanded level overview[/b]
- Giving you more info about each kill after you finish the level, making planning your next run a little easier.
[*] [b]New Graphics Settings[/b]
- Toggle post processing and lighting quality
[*] [b]Full Mixed Input Support[/b]
- Gyro users should find this incredibly helpful!
[*] [b]Gore Toggle[/b]
- Less blood, same action
[*] [b]Left Handed Mode[/b]
- Harding now holds their (or more than likely a COI guards) gun in their left hand. 
[/list]

[b]* Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Crouch bug fixed
[*] Default reticle displays when using traps/equipment instead of the 'no entry' one
[*] Snowmen can now be kicked (if you are so inclined)
[*] Enemy radio displays correctly
[*] Throwable objects no longer hit bullet shells
[*] A number of other small bug fixes
[/list]
You’ll also find some UI updates on the main menu that lets your cycle through multiple new features, general performance improvements and a number of bug fixes (listed above).

And with all of that completed, we can additionally say we're very close to some bigger updates we discussed in our post launch roadmap which launches very soon! These include:
[list]
[*] Gamepad Remapping
[*] No Timer Mode
[*] Ability to select specific bonus objectives before starting a level
[*] Ability to select level groups.
[/list]
We’ve been blown away by the support I Am Your Beast has received and it’s thanks to all of you that we have been able to continue supporting this game. THANK YOU!

See you on the internet, 

- Strange Scaffold.

notes.title: Golden Joystick Awards Nomination
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone, 

We’re incredibly honored to have I Am Your Beast nominated for a Golden Joystick award! Beast is in with some amazing titles under the [b]Indie Game - Self Published [/b]category and we would love it if you took the time to vote for us.

[url=https://www.futureevents.uk/goldenjoystickawards2024]VOTE HERE[/url]

While you’re there, be sure to vote in all the other categories as well because there have been a lot of great games out this year.

We’ve been blown away by the reception I Am Your Beast has recieved and we can’t thank you all enough! 

See you on the internet, 

– Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Twitch Integration!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

In another one of our little updates before some of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1876590/view/4569552815045935101?l=english]bigger ones,[/url] we’ve added Twitch integration to the game! This, once enabled, lets the game name COI agents after active users in your chat.

All you need to do is check the box in the settings menu and log in to your Twitch profile. The game will then pull from anyone actively chatting while you stream! 

As we mentioned, this is just one of a number of updates we have planned for I Am Your Beast, so keep your eyes out for updates!

See you on the internet!

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Update Notes 27th September
notes.notes:
Just a small hodge podge of fixes and quality of life stuff before the weekend. 

Quality of Life
- Expanded framerate limit options (including unlimited framerate)
- Independent volume sliders for effects and dialogue/cutscenes
- Mouse sensitivity options extended (can now go as high as 500%)

Bug Fixes
- A fix for players who were getting lingering temporary files when using the clip beta feature
- A fix for weapons falling through the ground on occassion after an enemy drops them
- a fix for an issue where reaching the top of a climbing wall or ladder would occassionally fling people into space 

These are "fingers crossed, should be fixed" so please tell us if you see these issues occurring still; we appreciate it!

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

We’re very excited to announce that I Am Your Beast is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck. Look at that lovely green checkmark!

We have some further updates to come, as well as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1876590/view/4664129675325963714?l=english]yesterday's clipping feature[/url] so be sure to keep watching this space.

See you out in the world, 

-- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Clip Creation Update Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

In the first of a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1876590/view/4569552815045935101?l=english]number of updates[/url], we’ve added a new beta feature that lets you capture those best runs directly in I Am Your Beast! 

Once you enable the clip feature in the settings menu, the game will record your run, and at the end, you can choose to keep it or move on! The video will be stored in your Video folder.

From there, you can share it wherever you like! Our [url=https://discord.gg/dog-airport-game]Discord[/url] is a great place (you’ll find a handy button in-game), but wherever video is supported, so is your clip!

The team has been blown away by the clips we’ve seen posted online so far (negative times, anyone?!), so we wanted to make the whole process as easy as possible!

See you (and your clips) on the internet!

- Strange Scaffold.

notes.title: Update for 16th September
notes.notes:
Smaller one today, fixing some stuttering that was occurring after the last update as well as (hopefully) fixing an unfortunate issue that some very patient players (thank you) are having on the start screen after crashes. 

Bullet points:
- Stuttering should be remedied for players experiencing that after the September 14th update
- Save files now create backups, which can be restored if the game crashes while saving
- Headway has, fingers crossed, been made on the start screen lock up bug

notes.title: Update Notes for 14th of September
notes.notes:
Another small patch out for those of you playing over the weekend. This one contains:
- An end of level pop up to tell you when you've unlocked a new level (as well as the conditions to unlock the next level)
- A fix for the ammo indicator sometimes displaying incorrectly 
- Improved enemy detection for claymore mines
- A potential fix for the falling through ground issue some players have reported 
- Backup saves and a catch for if a save game gets corrupted by the game being closed during the save process

notes.title: Update Notes 12th of September
notes.notes:
Got some fixes and quality of life stuff in here for you.  

The biggest ones: 
- Fix for the Story level 23 achievement not unlocking
- Fix for the S-ranking all Story/Challenge levels achievements not unlocking

In both cases, these should unlock automatically for you if you've already met the criteria when opening the level selection menu.

Additional stuff:
- Screenshake intensity can now be changed in settings
- To help with motion sickness, weapon recoil can now be applied to the reticle instead of camera motion with a settings toggle
- Equipment (bear traps, claymores, RPGs) can now be rebound in the settings menu
- Throwing knife kills now count towards objectives if an enemy has been knocked down

Happy hunting, folks!

notes.title: Update Notes 11th September 2024
notes.notes:
- Slightly lowered S rank threshold for Story level 15
- Bear Traps can be used on knocked down enemies
- 'New' will no longer show on challenge tab after attempting the newly unlocked level
- Fix for achievement not unlocking on Story level 25 (might have to replay this one to unlock it, but it's at least a short one)
- Fix to stop an enemies weapons from occassionally falling through the ground when dropped (particularly in Story level 2)

notes.title: I Am Your Beast is out today!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone – 

[b]HARDING IS HERE! [/b]

I Am Your Beast launches today and we wanted to take a second to say thank you to the entire community. The amount of excitement around the game has blown us away, and we’re so glad to have so many of you out there also appreciate a razor-sharp and focused FPS experience. As we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1876590/view/4569552815045935101?l=english]mentioned yesterday[/url], we have post-launch plans, but we’re so proud to be here at the finish line!

From everyone on the team, we sincerely hope you enjoy I Am Your Beast and thank you for joining us at launch--complete with a launch discount.

See you on the internet!

– Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Post Launch Plans for I Am Your Beast
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone –

I Am Your Beast launches tomorrow and we’re so excited to announce what some of our post-launch support will look like ahead of time. Your passion for our small team's work has been noted, and we're returning that support by bringing these features to life shortly after release:

[b]- NO TIMER MODE[/b]
   -   For players who get timer anxiety, you will eventually be able to disable the per-level timer.

[b]- MORE LEVELS[/b]
   - There will be more levels added for free post-launch, and they will probably be exceptionally challenging and/or weird.

[b]- EXPANDED LEVEL OVERVIEW [/b]
    - Level recaps will be expanded to let you showcase an even more granular picture of your flow through the level.

[b]- CONTROLLER REBINDING[/b]
    - Like its keyboard counterpart in the launch release, we intend to add controller rebinding as well shortly after launch.

[b]- SCOPE RIPPING[/b]
    - Scopes are for cowards. Alphonse Harding isn't a coward. Even though he already refuses to use scopes, Alphonse will soon rip the scopes off of sniper rifles he finds in a show of stylish dominance. DOOM (2016) vibes, basically.

I Am Your Beast is so close to launching, and we can’t wait to see what you can do with it. Crazy times, new routes, and movement exploits will surely abound!

In the meantime, thank you all so much for your wishlists and love for the game already. We hope to do it justice, and that Beast's stylish and frenetic world is as fun for you to play as it was for us to build it.

Until tomorrow!

Strange Scaffold

notes.title: I Am Your Beast Demo is BACK until September 3rd!
notes.notes:
You read that right, everyone! We’re bringing the Steam Next Fest demo for I Am Your Beast back online.

We so appreciate your patience with the game's delay, and kept hearing that people wanted to take one more swing at the demo (or never had a chance to play it), so we're re-listing it for a limited time. Build up your muscle memory, continue to share your plays on TikTok, Twitch and beyond, and get ready to put your skills in action in the full, greatly improved version of I Am Your Beast when it lands September 10th.

Thank you for your care for our game and team. See you on the internet!

- Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Delay Announcement | TYRANTS BETTER RUN... soon
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone – 

It’s with a heavy heart that we’re announcing a delay to the launch of I Am Your Beast. This is not something we take lightly and has involved a lot of internal discussion and review. 

The new launch date will be [b]September 10th[b].

We have been staggered by the amount of excitement I Am Your Beast has garnered since our reveal during the PC Gaming Show. Wishlist numbers have been the highest any of our titles have received, and we are determined to live up to that--while also ensuring the team can hit that goal in a healthy and sustainable way.

For those of you who have played the demo, you know this game is a special one. We know that as well. With that in mind, we don’t want to release anything that isn’t up to the standards of stability and quality you know and expect from Strange Scaffold.

Game development is difficult, time-consuming, and uncertain work at the best of times, and it’s never easy to make a decision like this. We’re a small team, and we appreciate and thank you for your passion, support, and patience. It’s what keeps us going.

See you at launch, 
– Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Get Your Time In The Game!
notes.notes:
Howdy, everyone -

So first, the bad news. The I Am Your Beast demo will come offline on July 31st. We know, we’re sorry. But, bonus, the game is releasing here on August 15th, so you won’t have long to wait! Even better news, we want to put something you do in the final game. 

Whoever can get the best time on the fourth level, Round The Twist, will get that time tucked away somewhere in the level itself on release. You’ve got one week to get your best time, get a video, and send it over to us! Here’s a few rules, because it’s not fun if there aren’t rules! Unless it is. 

▶️ No exploits.
▶️ A full video of the run is required. We suggest a YouTube upload!
▶️ If more than one fastest time is the same, whoever entered first takes it. 
▶️ Winner chosen at Strange Scaffold's discretion
▶️ The decision is final.
▶️ Entries no later than 9 am ET July 31st.

Best of luck, and see you on release day!

– Strange Scaffold.

notes.title: A huge thank you from the team behind I Am Your Beast
notes.notes:
Howdy, everyone —

The entire [i]I Am Your Beast[/i] development team would like to thank you all profusely for taking the time to experience a brief slice of what it’s like to be in Alphonse Harding’s boots. Whether you gave feedback, tried for a speedrun record, or mostly just threw several dozen wooden sticks at the heads of various soldiers with no real plan, we’re genuinely ecstatic about the fun you’ve all had with the game’s demo. As far as sandboxes go, you’ve all completely blown us away with your highly creative, often mind-boggling, and definitely Harding-approved means of making the Alaskan wilderness yours.

For now, the [b]demo will remain up and available to play[/b]! However, please note that [b]further changes and improvements will not be released for the demo itself[/b]. The whole [i]Beast[/i] team is charging ahead on getting the final title completed and ready for you to enact your wildest revenge schemes in, and that means all hands on deck to act on all of this fantastic feedback you’ve provided us.

Hope you’re all ready to sink your teeth in this August,

— Strange Scaffold
